comment: Facial action units (FACS) as regions of the face that move, and expressions that mix them. Sizes and moves are in mouth widths; directions in the face's own frame: up (mouth to eyes), front (out of the face, towards the nose tip), out (away from the face's middle). Regions sit at the face points placed as joints: mouth (mouth_l, mouth_r: the corners), eye (eye_l, eye_r: the lower lids), cheek (cheek_l, cheek_r: the cheekbones), nose (its tip); fold (nasolabial fold) lies between a mouth corner and the nose wing.
